comparison.objective: Flex-test ECG leads, identify the intermittent fault, and reject that lead.
comparison.physical_skill: Controlled cable bending, lamp observation, and connector removal.
comparison.success_condition: Fault evidence obtained before the faulty lead is removed and placed in the reject tray, without disturbing good leads.
comparison.reason: Interactive cable fault diagnosis has no adjustable stop, jam nut, countertorque, or retained-motion requirement.
